user.title: Satellite Controller
user.description: Lowers the music in a room while a voice satellite in that room is listening or speaking.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Satellite Controller is already set up.

data.skip_multi_room_groups: Skip groups that span several rooms

data_description.duck_percent: Each playing player loses this share of its own volume while a satellite in its room is busy.
data_description.restore_delay: Seconds to wait after the satellite is idle before the volume is restored. Useful for follow-up questions.
data_description.excluded_entities: Add players that lower their own music, such as the player of the satellite that speaks, when it shows up as a second player.
data_description.skip_multi_room_groups: A group is lowered as a whole. Turn this on to leave groups alone that also play in other rooms.
